Name: PlayerTether
Author: JellyHarper
Description:
💗 Player Tether — Multiplayer Leashes & Automatic Following

Stay close to your favorite farmer! 💕

Ever wanted to follow your friends around Stardew Valley without constantly controlling your character? Or maybe you've always wanted to take your favorite farmer for a little walk on a cute leash?

Player Tether is a multiplayer SMAPI mod that lets you attach yourself to another player and automatically follow them around the valley, complete with a customizable leash and matching collar!

Whether you're exploring the farm, wandering through Pelican Town, or just having a little fun with friends, Player Tether makes sticking together easier (and cuter!) than ever.

✨ Features

🐾 Automatic Player Following
Choose another player as your leader, and your character will automatically follow them. Walk and run to keep up, including around corners.

🌳 Smart Pathfinding
Your character walks around trees, rocks, fences, buildings, and other obstacles, and can move diagonally when the path is clear.

🏃 Speed Matching
Keep up with your leader. Your character matches their movement speed, including speed boosts, and catches up if you fall behind. Move on your own at any time and following pauses until you let go of the movement keys.

🎀 Customizable Leashes
The follower picks the leash color from the in-game menu. It updates right away, is saved for next time, and everyone with the mod sees the same color.

The menu includes a full color strip:
💙 Royal Blue, Sky Blue, Teal, and Aqua
💚 Green and Lime
💛 Yellow, Orange, and Amber
❤️ Bright Red and Maroon
💗 Blush, Hot Pink, Pink, Magenta, Purple, Violet, and Plum
🖤 Charcoal, Gray, Black, and Silver
🤍 White
💙 Blue
❤️ Red
🌈 Animated Rainbow

Each leash has a matching collar and a little heart-shaped tag.

👀 Multiplayer Visibility
Everyone with the mod installed can see the leashes and collars. A player who joins later still sees leashes that are already active. Several players can follow the same leader, each with their own color.

🎮 Easy In-Game Controls
F7: Open the Player Tether menu.
Right-click another farmer: Open the menu with that player already selected.
F6: Toggle automatic following.
Start Following: Begin following your selected player.
Stop Following: Pause automatic following.
Untether: Disconnect from your leader.

🏡 Map Transition Handling
If your leader enters a building or changes location, your character waits where you are until you are both on the same map again.

📦 Requirements
Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer
A multiplayer game for player-to-player tethering
Every player who should see the leash needs this mod installed

🔧 Installation
Install SMAPI if you haven't already.
Download Player Tether.
Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder, or install it with Vortex.
Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
Join or host a multiplayer game.
Press F7, or right-click a friend, to open the Player Tether menu.

💖 How to Use
Open the tether menu with F7, or right-click the player you want to follow.
Select that player if they are not already selected.
Choose a leash color.
Click Start Following.
Press F6 whenever you want to pause or resume following.

📝 Additional Notes
Player Tether is made for multiplayer.
The leash is the visual. Automatic following is what moves your character.
Only your own character moves. This mod does not move or teleport anyone else.
Followers do not enter buildings or change maps with their leader.
Keys, follow distance, pathfinding, and speed matching can be changed in config.json after the first launch. The default keys are F6 and F7.
Optional console commands: tether_list, tether_select, tether_toggle, tether_stop, and tether_status.
Movement may behave differently alongside other mods that change how farmers walk.

💗 Made by JellyHarper
Created for farmers who love sticking together, exploring together, and adding a little extra cuteness to their multiplayer adventures.

Happy farming, and don't wander too far! 🐾💕
